evidenceNotes: Original PDF page 1 and chapter 1 page 2 open 24 June and close 30 June 2026 at 11:59 PM. Correction/edit ends 2 July; original says no application fee for any advertised post.

Appendix A PDF pages 19–21 list four categories in two examination groups: 30 male and three female Assistant Superintendent Jail posts, 112 female and 1,093 male Warder posts. Total 1,238 vacancies across the four categories, with role-specific education, age and physical standards.

Chapter 1 requires candidates qualified in Group-C CET advertisement 01/2025. Appendix D CET policy PDF page 30 permits Indian citizens and conditionally Nepal/Bhutan subjects with Government eligibility certificate to enter CET. Final prison appointment permission is post-specific and not resolved by this CET clause.

All four role categories require Hindi or Sanskrit as a subject in Matric or Higher Education; no CEFR/numerical level appears. Exam paper is bilingual Hindi/English, distinct from a formal proficiency threshold.

Later official public notices dated 22/24 July and 3 August concern physical screening, including absentee candidate sessions. They do not announce a new application deadline. PDFs are retained separately for research and linked from the pending draft, but current connector does not extract candidate-level results or exam venues.

One advertisement and application portal are provisionally counted as one application cycle. Chapter 9 allows post preferences within groups; founder must confirm whether separate group forms make more than one distinct application cycle before approval.
